decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor still fits the sensing line, its keeping costs are low, and no adverse results require closing this option.
The MQTT proxy remains a very low-cost software option that supports connectivity, so the option is kept open.
The CO2 sensor remains aligned with environmental sensing and cheap to keep, so the option is retained.
The touch panel accessory has remained niche and its results no longer justify the resources, so the option is closed.
